en-US.description: OONI Probe is a free and open source software designed to measure internet censorship and other forms of network interference.
en-US.name: OONI Probe
en-US.releaseNotes:
Release Notes
- Measurement engine (org.ooni:oonimkall*) v3.31.1
- Passport (org.ooni:passport*) 0.1.8
- Add Serbian language support
- Bug fixes and improvements

What's Changed
- Fix scaled value bug by @sdsantos in #1653
- Disabled tests should not run by @sdsantos in #1654
- Fix network filter name that could be have null by @sdsantos in #1655
- Enable deselection of a result with error by @sdsantos in #1656
- Validate host should support longer TLDs and localhost by @sdsantos in #1657
- chore(deps): bump ktor from 3.6.0 to 3.6.1 by @dependabot[bot] in #1650
- chore(deps): bump io.sentry.android.gradle from 6.24.0 to 6.25.0 by @dependabot[bot] in #1649
- build(deps): update oonimkall to 3.31.1 by @aanorbel in #1659
- Translations update from Localization Lab Weblate by @weblate in #1660
- feat(i18n): add Serbian and Serbian Cyrillic locales to language options by @aanorbel in #1661
- chore: bump app version to 6.3.1 by @aanorbel in #1665
